title: Distinct fail when changing slaves index

comments.body: Is it possible that the settings i set to the index are not applied to the slaves index ?

That's it, i have to apply the same settings on slaves index.
Is it a normal behavior ?
I didn't manage to reproduce the issue on your website from the provided URL. I switch between the three indices but I always get the same number of results. Did I miss something?

Yes i apply the settings on all slaves index too so the problem is resolved.
But i would like to know if this behavior is normal ?

If I understand correctly the issue was: the settings were not applied on the replicas right? Yes it's the expected behaviour. You have to provide an options to apply the [`setSettings`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/api-methods/set-settings/?language=javascript) call to the replicas, it's [`forwardToReplicas `](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/api-methods/set-settings/?language=javascript#method-param-forwardtoreplicas).
